Final owner login = 200, display_name restored to 'Vamsi Madhav'. Password sheet shows edit-current-pw + edit-new-pw; email sheet shows edit-new-email + edit-email-current-pw. PARITY: The 4 required editable rows (display name, email, password, avatar affordance) and the gear→Settings drill-down are present on BOTH web and mobile with matching testids (mobile Payment methods uses testID 'settings-payment-methods' per label-slugify vs web uses 'settings-payments' — both are as-spec'd in review request).

Security row shows pill 'JWT' whereas web Settings › Security shows no pill (just desc 'Privacy & data policy'). Minor copy divergence — spec did not mandate one over the other, but consider aligning to a single presentation for parity.

critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/auth/profile with display_name='' silently persists as null via `body.display_name.strip()[:60] or None` (server.py L1563). UI then falls back to `owner?.email?.split('@')[0]` = 'owner'. Not a bug, but the UX may confuse an owner who tries to clear the field expecting to see their previous name preserved. Consider either (a) preventing empty-string submissions in the client, or (b) leaving prior value untouched when the trimmed value is empty.

backend/server.py L1583: change-email sets `credentials_customized: true`. Combined with seed_owner's guard (auth.py — skip .env re-sync once customized), a change persists across restarts. The tests here only exercised NEGATIVE change-email paths so the owner email was never mutated, but the same guard means a future testing agent must always revert if they exercise the happy path. Worth documenting in test_credentials.md.

MOBILE parity — /app/mobile/app/settings.tsx uses `settings-${label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-')}` so any label rename silently changes the testID. WEB parallels this pattern in some rows but hard-codes 'settings-payments' vs the mobile 'settings-payment-methods'. Suggest passing explicit testids everywhere.

MOBILE — /app/mobile/app/account.tsx displays both Settings-style rows (account-setting-payments/notifications/security under 'General settings' section at L279-283) AND the gear→/settings screen. This is dead-simple duplication; the whole /settings drill-down list already renders the same rows. Consider removing the inline 'General settings' block from /account since the review-spec now moves them behind the gear.
